```{r Libraries}

## Load the libraries ##
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(purrr)
library(broom)
library(ggtext)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom.helpers)
library(writexl)
library(patchwork)

```

```{r Load the data}

Dataframes_Final_Sign <- read_csv(file = "~/SLE/Glycans/Output_Data/Glycans_marker_data_sign.csv")
Comparator_Values_Long <- read_csv(file = "~/SLE/Glycans/Output_Data/Comparator_values_long.csv")
Comparator_Values <- read_csv(file = "~/SLE/Glycans/Output_Data/Comparator_values.csv")

Comparator_Levels <- c("AI", "CI", "eGFR", "UPCR", "SLEDAI-2K")

Glycan_Deltas <- Dataframes_Final_Sign %>% 
  group_by(ID, Marker) %>% 
  mutate(M_Delta = order_by(Time_point, Value - lag(Value)), 
         M_Delta = ifelse(is.na(M_Delta), 0, M_Delta)) %>%
  filter(Time_point == "T12") %>% 
  select(-c(Time_point, Value, Origin)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = ID, 
              names_from = Marker, 
              values_from = M_Delta) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "ID")

Comparator_Values_Delta <- Comparator_Values_Long %>% 
  rename(Comp_Value = "Value") %>% 
  group_by(ID, Comparator) %>% 
  mutate(Comp_Delta = order_by(Time_point, Comp_Value - lag(Comp_Value)), 
         Comp_Delta = ifelse(is.na(Comp_Delta), 0, Comp_Delta)) %>% 
  filter(Time_point == "T12") %>% 
  select(-c(Time_point, Comp_Value)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = ID, 
              names_from = Comparator, 
              values_from = Comp_Delta) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "ID")

DFs_Delta_Combined <- cbind(Glycan_Deltas, Comparator_Values_Delta) 

```

```{r Delta - Delta correlation}

Correlations_Delta <- expand_grid(Marker = colnames(Glycan_Deltas), 
              Comparator = colnames(Comparator_Values_Delta)) %>% 
  mutate(test = map2(Marker, 
                     Comparator, ~ cor.test(DFs_Delta_Combined[[.x]], 
                                          DFs_Delta_Combined[[.y]], 
                                          method = "spearman", 
                                          exact  = FALSE)),
         rho = map_dbl(test, "estimate"), 
         p.value = map_dbl(test, "p.value", )) %>%
  mutate(P_adjust = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>% 
  select(-test) %>% 
  mutate(Origin = sub("_.*$", "", Marker), 
         Origin = factor(Origin, levels = c("AGP", "C3", "Fab", "Fc", "IgG", "Serum"))) %>% 
  rename(Correlation = "rho") %>% 
  mutate(Significance = case_when(p.value < 0.05 ~ "*"), 
         Comparator = factor(Comparator, levels = Comparator_Levels))

```

```{r Delta visualisation prep and save the tables}

Correlations_Delta_Sign <- Correlations_Delta %>%
  group_by(Marker) %>% 
  filter(any(Significance == "*")) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  separate(col = Marker, into = c("Origin", "Marker"), sep = "_", extra = "merge", fill = "right")

max_len_Delta <- Correlations_Delta_Sign %>%
  pull(Marker) %>%
  nchar() %>%
  max(na.rm = TRUE)

Correlations_Delta_Sign_2 <- Correlations_Delta_Sign %>% 
  mutate(Marker_2 = str_pad(Marker, width = max_len_Delta, side = "left", pad = "\u00A0"))
```

```{r Glycan deltas - Histology prep}
Histology_Data <- read_csv(file = "~/SLE/Glycans/Output_Data/Histology_data.csv")

  rownames_to_column(var = "ID") %>%

Histology_columns <- Histology_Data %>%
```

```{r Delta - Histology correlation}

compute_Delta_Hist_Cor <- function(combined_DF, Time_label) {
  expand_grid(Marker = colnames(Glycan_Deltas), 
              Histology = Histology_columns) %>% 
  mutate(test = map2(Marker, Histology, ~ cor.test(combined_DF[[.x]], 
                                                   combined_DF[[.y]], 
                                                   method = "spearman", 
                                                   exact = FALSE)),
         rho = map_dbl(test, "estimate"), 
         p.value = map_dbl(test, "p.value", )) %>%
  mutate(P_adjust = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH")) %>% 
  select(-test) %>% 
  mutate(Origin = sub("_.*$", "", Marker)) %>% 
  rename(Correlation = "rho") %>% 
  mutate(Significance = case_when(p.value < 0.05 ~ "*"), 
         Time_label = Time_label)

}

Delta_Hist_Cor_T0 <- compute_Delta_Hist_Cor(Delta_Hist_T0, "0")
Delta_Hist_Cor_T12 <- compute_Delta_Hist_Cor(Delta_Hist_T12, "12")

Delta_Hist_Cor_Res <- rbind(Delta_Hist_Cor_T0, Delta_Hist_Cor_T12) %>% 
  inner_join(Category_Data, by = c("Histology" = "Result"))
```

```{r}

Glycan_Annotations_clean <- read_xlsx("~/SLE/Glycans/Output_Data/Gl_annotations_clean.xlsx") %>% 
  mutate(Glycan_Annotation = gsub(" - Multiple Structures", "", Glycan_Annotation)) %>% 
  select(Origin, Marker, Glycan_Annotation)

# 1) Wrap your pipeline into a function
process_DF <- function(df) {
  df2 <- df %>%
    inner_join(Glycan_Annotations_clean, by = c("Origin", "Marker"))
  
  max_len <- df2 %>%
    pull(Glycan_Annotation) %>%
    nchar() %>%
    max(na.rm = TRUE)
  
  df2 <- df2 %>% 
    mutate(Marker = str_pad(Marker, width = max_len, side = "left", pad = "\u00A0"),
           Glycan_Annotation = str_pad(Glycan_Annotation, width = max_len, side = "left", pad = "\u00A0"))
  
  DF <- df2 %>%
    mutate(RowKey = interaction(Marker, Glycan_Annotation, sep = " | ", drop = TRUE, lex.order = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  row_levels <- DF %>%
    arrange(Origin, across(any_of(c("Comparator", "Histology"))), Marker) %>%
    pull(RowKey) %>%
    unique()
  
  lab_map <- DF %>%
    distinct(RowKey, Glycan_Annotation) %>%
    tibble::deframe()
  
  DF <- DF %>%
    mutate(RowKey = factor(RowKey, levels = row_levels), 
           Marker = str_pad(Marker, width = max_len, side = "left", pad = "\u00A0"),
           Glycan_Annotation = str_pad(Glycan_Annotation, width = max_len, side = "left", pad = "\u00A0"),
           RowKey = str_pad(as.character(RowKey), width = max_len, side = "left", pad = "\u00A0"))
  
  return(list(DF = DF, lab_map = lab_map))
}

Correlations_Delta_Sign_2_processed <- process_DF(Correlations_Delta_Sign_2)
Glycan_Deltas_vs_M12_Cor_Sign_2_processed <- process_DF(Glycan_Deltas_vs_M12_Cor_Sign_2)
Delta_Hist_Cor_Res_Sign_2_processed <- process_DF(Delta_Hist_Cor_Res_Sign_2)

```

```{r Fix each plot again - Marker deltas vs Histologies}

Plot_delta_hist_cor <- function(Dataframe_clean, lab_map, Time, Title) {
  
  Dataframe_clean <- Dataframe_clean %>% 
    filter(Time_label == Time) %>% 
    group_by(Origin, Marker) %>% 
    filter(any(Significance == "*")) %>% 
    ungroup()

  max_len_current <- Dataframe_clean %>%
    pull(Marker) %>%
    nchar() %>%
    max(na.rm = TRUE)

  Dataframe_clean_2 <- Dataframe_clean %>%
    mutate(Marker_2 = str_pad(Marker, width = max_len_current, side = "left", pad = "\u00A0"),
           Origin = gsub("Serum", "Serum<br>N-glycome", Origin))
  
  this_plot <- ggplot(Dataframe_clean_2, aes(x = Histology, y = RowKey, fill = Correlation)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", width = 1, height = 1) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "dodgerblue", mid = "white", high = "firebrick", 
                         limits = c(Corr_scale$min_corr, Corr_scale$max_corr),
                         midpoint = 0, breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.5), 
                         guide = guide_colorbar(order = 1, title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0, 
                                                title = "Spearman<br>Correlation", title.theme = element_markdown(face = "bold"))) +
    facet_grid(Origin ~ Category, scales = "free", space = "free") +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0), drop = TRUE, labels = function(x) gsub("<br>", "\n", x, fixed = TRUE)) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = lab_map, expand = expansion(add = 0.8)) +
    # scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.8)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = Significance), vjust = 0.7, hjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold", size = 7) +
    labs(title = paste0("Correlations between changes in glycan markers and clinical/histopathological features: ", 
                        Title), 
         x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(strip.placement = "outside",
          strip.text.y.right = element_markdown(size = 11, 
                                                angle = 0, 
                                                hjust = 0.5, 
                                                vjust = 0.5, 
                                                face = "bold", 
                                                margin = margin(t = 3,
                                                                r = 3, 
                                                                b = 3, 
                                                                l = 3)),
          strip.text.x.top = element_markdown(size = 11, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, face  = "bold"),
          axis.text.x = element_markdown(size = 11, angle = 60, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, 
                                         # face = "bold", 
                                         colour = "black"), 
          axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 11, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
          panel.grid  = element_blank(), 
          panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"), 
          plot.caption.position = "plot", 
          plot.caption = element_markdown(hjust = 0.9, vjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_markdown(face = "bold", lineheight = 1.2))

  this_plot
}

Delta_Hist_T0_cor_plot <- Plot_delta_hist_cor(Delta_Hist_Cor_Res_Sign_2_processed$DF, 
                                              Delta_Hist_Cor_Res_Sign_2_processed$lab_map, 0, "Baseline")
Delta_Hist_T12_cor_plot <- Plot_delta_hist_cor(Delta_Hist_Cor_Res_Sign_2_processed$DF, 
                                               Delta_Hist_Cor_Res_Sign_2_processed$lab_map, 12, "Month 12")

Delta_Hist_T0_cor_plot
Delta_Hist_T12_cor_plot
```
